aspect-of-anger-management.power: While above [55–40] Fury, you are Berserk, but 2 Fury drains per second.

aspect-of-channeling.power: While channeling a Skill, all damage is increased by 70%[x].

aspect-of-coagulation.power: Gain 30% increased Fortify Generation and [15–20]% Damage Reduction while Fortified.

aspect-of-heavenly-strength.power: While wielding a Two-Handed Weapon, gain [20–30]% Damage Reduction.

aspect-of-limitless-rage.power: Each point of Fury you generate increases your damage by 1.50%[x]. This bonus is lost after 4 seconds.

battle-mad-aspect.power: After swapping weapons 5 times, gain Berserking for 4 seconds. Additionally, you deal 15%[x] increased damage while Berserking.

bold-chieftains-aspect.power: Your Shout Skill Cooldowns are reduced by [8–10] seconds.

crushing-aspect.power: While Fortified, you deal 65%[x] increased damage.

edgemasters-aspect.power: Skills deal up to 60%[x] increased damage based on your available Primary Resource when cast, receiving the maximum benefit while you have full Primary Resource.

heavy-hitting-aspect.power: Your Skills that create Iron Shrapnel, Earthquakes, or Dust Devils deal 60%[x] increased damage.

steadfast-berserkers-aspect.power: Gain 6% of your Maximum Life as Fortify whenever you deal direct damage while Berserking.

vehement-brawlers-aspect.power: Casting an Ultimate Skill increases your damage by [10–30]%[x] for 8 seconds and grants 4 additional Ultimate Skill Ranks.

wildbolt-aspect.power: Every 1.5 seconds, Distant enemies are Pulled In to you and take 15%[x] increased damage from you.
